entries.name: Employer social security contributions
entries.statute: US SSA, Social Security Programs Throughout the World (SSPTW), Africa 2019 — Botswana (Wayback copy, R4/fetch/ssptw11/botswana.txt)
entries.why: BW has no contributory social insurance: old-age pension is universal ('Employer Universal: None ... Government Universal: The total cost'), sickness/maternity and work injury are employer-liability systems (benefits paid directly or insured with private carriers), not contributions to a public fund. Secondary source (2019), no later statute creating a contribution found. Human Resource Development Levy is on turnover (not payroll), noted under P7.

entries.name: Transfer duty on acquisitions of immovable property by citizens (5 % of the value above P1 500 000)
entries.statute: Transfer Duty Act Cap. 53:01 as amended by the Transfer Duty (Amendment) Act 2023 (in force 3 May 2023), per the BURS public notice (Wayback 2023-05-09, R4/fetch/p13/bw_tda2023.pdf: citizen exemption threshold raised from P1 000 000 to P1 500 000) and the BURS declaration form 'Transfer of immovable property' (computation 'Citizen @ 5% ((value less P1M)*5%)', R4/fetch/p13/bw_tip.pdf). Act text not read (official secondary). Liability: the transferee
entries.doc: BURS notice 2023: 'Increase in the exemption threshold on transfer of immovable property by citizens from P1,000,000 to P1,500,000'; 'Reduction on the rate of transfer duty by non-citizens from 30 per cent to a progressive rate of 10 per cent for the first P2,000,000 and 15 per cent on the excess'. Thirteenth pass.
unsupported: non-citizen acquirers (10 % to P2 000 000, 15 % above): citizenship is not an input, the citizen rate is applied
company acquirers (rate by citizen ownership) not modelled
transactions chargeable to VAT are waived (2023)
the citizen rate of 5 % is read from the pre-2023 form (flag)

entries.name: Withholding tax on dividends received by residents (15 %, final)
entries.statute: Income Tax Act Cap. 52:01 s. 58 and Seventh Schedule, per the BURS page 'Withholding Taxes' (fetched 2025-09-17, R4/fetch/bw10/wht_20250917.html: 'Withholding tax on dividends applies to both residents and non-residents at the rate of 15% and it is a final tax'); official secondary
entries.doc: BURS: dividends, section 58 and the 7th Schedule: 15 % for residents and non-residents, final. Thirteenth pass.
unsupported: residents' interest (withholding above P1 500 a quarter; rate table not read)
